rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Demosthene
"Come my son... It is time for you to receive the royal crown and replace me as Emperor of Nevendaar."

Uther
"You really want me to replace you,  father? I have no use for your puny crown. It means nothing to me..."

Demosthene
"What!? you refuse the imperial crown... Why this reaction? Explain yourself, my son!"

Uther
"I am not what you think I am, old man!  I crave more than a mortal's crown made of metal..."

Demosthene
"What are you doing? Who... who are you? You are not my son! That foul look in your eyes..."

Uther
"What will you do now without your precious Emperor? Join me while you still live! I leave you to my little friends! Ha ha ha ha..."

Elf Ranger
"How dare you attack us, humans! Fear not, our brothers will avenge us!"

Uther
"Ha ha! By killing me you only made me stronger... Single-minded creatures! Now that you have spilled the blood of your own heir, I can become my true form."

Demon Uther
"Prepare yourselves to die, humans! Uther is the new ruler of Hell!"

Spearman
"Flee! Uther has become a Demon. Evacuate the lands!"

Spearman
"What happened? What was that sorcery we saw?  Why did Uther leave?"

Peasant
"Uther has killed the Emperor! Flee! Demons have entered the city! We are doomed!"
Avenge Demosthene's death by destroying Uther

Cultist
"You were warned not to pursue the Legions! Bethrezen is back... To fight us now is pure folly!"
Imperial Knight"We will fall for your tricks no more! It is time we rid the lands of your treacherous kind."

Dwarf
"Why attack us? We should ally our  nations and fight against the heretic child..."

Archmage
"This is no place for our troops to tarry. Let's move forward... Uther must be stopped!"

Elf Ranger
"We heard about the Emperor's death! We regret that we cannot help you, as we must settle a problem first. Please, do not intrude into our territory to the east... "

Elf Guard
"Approach no more... These are Elven lands - only elves are allowed here. If you attempt to enter you will be resisted."

Inquisitor
"We have recaptured the city. Let's be cautious master... Uther will surely retaliate for this assault!"
Spearman"Have you nothing better to do than attack us? Why do you not avenge your Emperor's death, cowards..."

Initiate
"Mortis ordered us to kill Uther... We have the same aims - why do we not ally?"

Uther
"You will pay dearly for this! Why do you not see... You are not my equals!"

Squire
"Lord, the Elves have sent a messenger. He wishes for you to meet with him."
Elf Messenger"Human friend. We will help you - in exchange for a small service. Please destroy the living dead south of our realm, their presence threatens us greatly!"
Elf Centaur"Thank you friend! You have destroyed the Undead creatures! The Elves will remember this - please accept this gift as reward..."
